description: Unit test class for ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter, testing its behavior with various MDC entries, logging levels, and factory/mock interactions.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter, verifying behavior with MDC, logging levels, and factory interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock behavior for loggingAdapterWithEmptyMdc before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Verifies that setMDC is not called on loggingAdapterWithEmptyMdc after each test.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullDiagnosticLoggingAdapterFactory
methods.description: Tests that passing null to ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter.of() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: withSameCorrelationIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Verifies that calling withCorrelationId() with the same ID returns the same instance.

methods.name: withCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Checks that info() logs correctly when info level is enabled with a correlation ID.

methods.name: doNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that info() does not log when info level is disabled.

methods.name: withNullCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Verifies behavior when null correlation ID is used; logs directly without setting MDC.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntryPairsLogDebugInfoWarningAndError
methods.description: Tests logging at multiple levels with multiple MDC entries, verifying setMDC and notifyX calls.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntriesLogError
methods.description: Verifies error logging with MDC entries and exception.

methods.name: removeCorrelationIdViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests removing MDC entries by setting null value for correlation ID.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Checks removal of specific MDC entry via key.
